essence: The mantra structure assigns bhakāra and the Sadyojāta series to the lords of forms and the individual selves.
The root aṇu mantra is formed by adding a dative ending to one's own name.
The Gaṅgā rite must be carried out strictly according to the previously described procedure.
After the prior steps, one should offer sesame along with cloth and gold rings.
The preeminent guru should place pots before each respective deity.
